item.title: Fall Back into Learning with Citywide Training & Development
item.description:
As the leaves begin to change and the air turns crisp, it’s the perfect time to embrace new opportunities for personal and professional growth.  Citywide Training & Development is thrilled to announce our lineup of exciting fall courses designed to help you thrive in your career and expand your knowledge.

Explore our Fall Quarter Course Catalog for a diverse range of subjects offered either in-person or virtually.  Don’t miss out on this opportunity to invest in your future.  Whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career journey, our course lineup has something for everyone.

Ready to take the next step?  Enroll today!

item.title: Citywide Training & Development Website - How to Find Us
item.description:
Have you visited the new and improved City of Columbus website? 

 

The fresh designs and features are sure to enhance your experience.   While you’re there, be sure to visit Citywide Training & Development and register for training.  Here are a few screenshots on how to find us.

 

STEP 1:

Go to https://new.columbus.gov/Home

 

STEP 2:

Type Training in the search engine.

Select Human Resources.

 

STEP 3:

Click on Citywide Training & Development.

 

STEP 4:

You are now on the Citywide Training & Development Website!

 

Encouraging your learning journey,

 

The Citywide Training & Development Team

item.title: July – September 2023 Course Offerings through Citywide Training & Development
item.description:
Check out the July-September 2023 THRIVE Sessions!

Small Business Catalog:

Summer is coming in HOT and so are our professional and personal development classes!

Citywide Training & Development is offering a great lineup of classes specifically designed to help small business owners and their valued employees to learn, grow and thrive!  Registration is open and available for Summer Quarter (July – September).  Scan the QR code to view course offerings, see if  you qualify for FREE training and register for classes.

Want to learn more about FREE training opportunities?  Contact us at CTD@columbus.gov or call 614-8294 for more information.

We look forward to engaging with you soon!

The Citywide Training & Development Team
